5.1 Description
The Zest TM Petite Nasal Mask is a respiratory mask which is non invasive, the
Silicone Seal is positioned over the nose, and it seals on the area around the nose,
and the upper lip. The mask is held on the face with headgear straps. It connects to a
single breathing tube via a swivel adaptor, to receive pressurized gases. On the
mask base are exhalation vents (bias holes) that allow exhaled gases to be
continually flushed and removed to room air. The silicone seal is contoured for
comfort and to reduce leakage.
5.2 Intended Use
The Zest'm Petite Nasal Mask is intended to be used by individuals greater than
661bs (30kg) who have been diagnosed by a physician as requiring CPAP or Bi-Level
Ventilator treatment. The ZestTM Petite Nasal Mask is intended for Single Patient
Use in the home and Multiple Patient Use in the hospital or other clinical setting
where proper disinfection of the device can occur between patient uses.
5.3 Technological Characteristics Comparison
The ZeStTM Petite Nasal Mask is very similar to the predicate Fisher & Paykel
Healthcare ZeStM Nasal Mask. Both masks are for non continuous ventilation, and
deliver CPAP gasses through the nose. The main difference is that the Zest Petite
Nasal Mask is a smaller size than the Zest Nasal Mask. The overall dimensions of
the Zest Petite Nasal Mask are smaller and the silicone seal is smaller. All the
technology, features and specifications are identical. The only difference is that it will
fit patients with smaller faces.
5.4 Nan-clinical Tests
Testing of the ZeStTM Petite Nasal Mask was compared to the predicate Fisher &
Paykel Healthcare ZeStM Nasal Mask for performance and for biocompatibility.
These tests demonstrate substantial equivalence of the Zest TM Petite Nasal Mask to
the predicate mask. Copies of test reports are included in Appendix B.
5.5 Conclusion
The comparison of features, performance, and biocompatibility are identical the
predicate Fisher & Paykel Healthcare ZestTm Nasal Mask (K083832) and the HC432
Full Face Mask (K061*236) for biocompatibility.
The comparison of intended use 661bs (30kg) is identical to the predicate Respironics
Comfortoel Blue Nasal Mask (K092835) and is identical to the Fisher & Paykel
Healthcare ZestTm Nasal Mask (K083832) in terms of Single Patient Use in the home
and Multiple Patient Use in the hospital or other clinical setting.
The ZestTM Petite Nasal Mask is proven to be safe and effective for CPAP and Bi-
level ventilation therapy.
